newsitem.title: USA: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean basis offers slide.
newsitem.headline: FOB Gulf Grain - Soybean basis offers slide.

text.p: U.S. FOB Gulf soybean basis offers declined about two cents per bushel for June and July positions largely in reaction to the sharp gains in CBOT soybean futures, dealers said. Also, demand was light.
Corn and winter wheat basis values were mostly unchanged.

Dealers said barges were beginning to flow on the Mississippi River as water levels continued to drop. However, delays continue because of the large backup of barges that occurred when water levels were high and locks were closed.
"It takes a little while for the equipment to get spread out over the system," said one dealer.

Winter wheat values were unchanged. Two South Korean firms bought 21,000 tonnes of wheat for June 5-July 5 shipment. Also, USDA said exporters reported 110,000 tonnes of 1997/98 hard red winter wheat was sold to unknown destinations.
